CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.pickup_document_assert(p_owner uuid, p_actor uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$begin
 if p_owner is null or p_actor is null or not exists(select 1 from public.app_users u join public.workspaces w on w.id=u.data_owner_id
 where u.user_id=p_actor and u.data_owner_id=p_owner and u.active and w.status in ('active','trialing') and (u.role='admin' or 'orders'=any(u.permissions))) then raise exception 'PICKUP_ACCESS_DENIED' using errcode='42501';end if;
end$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tracking_finish(p_order uuid, p_run uuid, p_identity text, p_event jsonb, p_next timestamp with time zone, p_error text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET lock_timeout TO '25ms'
AS $function$
declare s public.shipment_tracking_state; o public.fulfillment_orders;
begin
 select * into s from public.shipment_tracking_state where order_id=p_order and lease_id=p_run and identity_key=p_identity and lease_until>now() for update;
 if not found then return false;end if;
 select * into o from public.fulfillment_orders where id=p_order and owner_id=s.owner_id for share;
 if not found or o.pii_purged_at is not null or private.shipment_tracking_identity(o)<>p_identity or o.label_cancelled_at is not null
 or private.shipment_tracking_terminal(s.provider,o.tracking_status_code) then return false;end if;

 -- Lock current account/workspace rows until this observation commits. Account
 -- disablement, reassignment or provider changes during HTTP invalidate it.
 PERFORM 1 FROM public.integration_accounts a
 JOIN public.workspaces w ON w.id=a.owner_id
 WHERE a.id=s.account_id AND a.owner_id=s.owner_id AND a.provider=s.provider
 AND a.enabled AND a.status<>'disabled' AND w.status IN('active','trialing')
 FOR SHARE OF a,w;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 if (p_error is null OR p_error ~ '^MRW_UNKNOWN_STATUS_([0-9]{1,4}|UNKNOWN)$') and p_event is not null then
 WITH incoming AS (
  SELECT p_event AS event,false AS provider_history
  UNION ALL
  SELECT item.event,true FROM jsonb_array_elements(
   CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p_event->'history')='array' THEN p_event->'history' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
  ) WITH ORDINALITY AS item(event,n)
  WHERE item.n<=200 AND jsonb_typeof(item.event)='object'
 ), canonical AS (
  -- Explicit fields prevent nested histories, recipient details, warnings and
  -- observation/check times from entering either the record or its identity.
  SELECT DISTINCT jsonb_build_object(
   'state',event->>'state','code',left(event->>'code',120),
   'message',left(event->>'message',500),
   'eventAt',CASE WHEN nullif(event->>'eventAt','') IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE
    to_char((event->>'eventAt')::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') END,
   'eventTimeRaw',left(event->>'eventTimeRaw',40)
  ) AS event,provider_history FROM incoming
 ), movements AS (
  -- A reduced current state can retain the previous known state for an
  -- unknown status. The provider's history is the actual event; do not insert
  -- a second copy of it with the reducer's retained classification.
  SELECT DISTINCT ON(event-'state') event FROM canonical
  ORDER BY event-'state',provider_history DESC,event
 )
 INSERT INTO public.shipment_tracking_events(order_id,owner_id,account_id,identity_key,event_key,normalized_state,raw_code,raw_message,event_at,raw_event_time)
 SELECT p_order,s.owner_id,s.account_id,p_identity,md5(c.event::text),c.event->>'state',c.event->>'code',c.event->>'message',nullif(c.event->>'eventAt','')::timestamptz,c.event->>'eventTimeRaw'
 FROM movements c
 -- Earlier releases keyed the whole poll including observation time. Reuse
 -- equivalent legacy movements without modifying any pre-existing event.
 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.shipment_tracking_events e
  WHERE e.order_id=p_order AND e.identity_key=p_identity
  AND e.normalized_state IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.event->>'state'
  AND e.raw_code IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.event->>'code'
  AND e.raw_message IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.event->>'message'
  AND e.event_at IS NOT DISTINCT FROM nullif(c.event->>'eventAt','')::timestamptz
  AND e.raw_event_time IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.event->>'eventTimeRaw')
 ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
 end if;
 update public.shipment_tracking_state set
 normalized_state=case when (p_error is null OR p_error ~ '^MRW_UNKNOWN_STATUS_([0-9]{1,4}|UNKNOWN)$') then p_event->>'state' else normalized_state end,
 raw_code=case when (p_error is null OR p_error ~ '^MRW_UNKNOWN_STATUS_([0-9]{1,4}|UNKNOWN)$') then left(p_event->>'code',120) else raw_code end,
 raw_message=case when (p_error is null OR p_error ~ '^MRW_UNKNOWN_STATUS_([0-9]{1,4}|UNKNOWN)$') then left(p_event->>'message',500) else raw_message end,
 event_at=case when (p_error is null OR p_error ~ '^MRW_UNKNOWN_STATUS_([0-9]{1,4}|UNKNOWN)$') then nullif(p_event->>'eventAt','')::timestamptz else event_at end,
 raw_event_time=case when (p_error is null OR p_error ~ '^MRW_UNKNOWN_STATUS_([0-9]{1,4}|UNKNOWN)$') then left(p_event->>'eventTimeRaw',40) else raw_event_time end,
 observed_at=case when (p_error is null OR p_error ~ '^MRW_UNKNOWN_STATUS_([0-9]{1,4}|UNKNOWN)$') then nullif(p_event->>'observedAt','')::timestamptz else observed_at end,
 movement_at=case when (p_error is null OR p_error ~ '^MRW_UNKNOWN_STATUS_([0-9]{1,4}|UNKNOWN)$') then nullif(p_event->>'movementAt','')::timestamptz else movement_at end,
 last_checked_at=case when (p_error is null OR p_error ~ '^MRW_UNKNOWN_STATUS_([0-9]{1,4}|UNKNOWN)$') then now() else last_checked_at end,
 next_poll_at=p_next,failures=case when (p_error is null OR p_error ~ '^MRW_UNKNOWN_STATUS_([0-9]{1,4}|UNKNOWN)$') then 0 else failures+1 end,
 last_error=left(p_error,100),lease_id=null,lease_until=null where order_id=p_order;
 return true;
EXCEPTION WHEN lock_not_available THEN
 -- Roll back this candidate's function writes and let a later run retry it.
 RETURN false;
end;$function$
